blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The trough of the tropical depression (TD) will continue to bring rains over Visayas and Mindanao on Wednesday, Sept. 23, the state weather bureau said. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Benison Estareja said during its 5 p.m. weather advisory that the extension of the TD outside of the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) will bring gloomy skies with scattered rains over the following areas: “Base sa ating latest satellite animation, itong trough pa rin po o yung buntot ng bagyo, ang siyang nagpapaulan sa malaking bahagi ng Visayas and Mindanao, lalo na sa […]...
